sql: SELECT id, status FROM article LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM brief LIMIT 3; SELECT * FROM factbox LIMIT 3; SELECT * FROM covers LIMIT 3; SELECT * FROM topic LIMIT 3; SELECT * FROM passage LIMIT 3
SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status
SELECT * FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23'
SELECT * FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]
SELECT parent, seq, cut, content FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7] ORDER BY parent, seq
SELECT parent, count() AS c FROM passage GROUP BY parent
SELECT * FROM covers WHERE in IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]
SELECT id, title, body FROM article WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR body CONTAINS 'spike' OR body CONTAINS 'retract' OR title CONTAINS 'kill' OR title CONTAINS 'pull'
SELECT article.status AS status, count() FROM covers GROUP BY status
